description: A cream canvas tote with dark straps sits on a pink bed sheet in front of a pale backdrop, with a small pink plush toy lying to the left. The left hand grips and lifts the tote while the right hand helps pull the opening wide, and both hands reach inside to spread and reshape it into an open upright bag (two-hand object), then the left hand picks up the pink plush and drops it into the tote as the right hand steadies the bag (left-hand object: plush, right-hand object: tote).
